_comment: Pterodactyl egg for the RyzeSMP Test Client + AI remote-control service. Import under a Nest, then create a server from it. Clones the ryze-test/ subdir of the Minecraft-mods repo.
name: RyzeSMP Test Client
author: noreply@anthropic.com
description: Browser remote Minecraft test client + MCP interface for AI-assisted RyzeSMP testing. Separate from the suggestions bot.
startup: cd /home/container; if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then /usr/local/bin/npm install --no-audit --no-fund || true; fi; if [ ! -f dist/index.js ]; then /usr/local/bin/npm run build; fi; /usr/local/bin/node dist/index.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y git curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /tmp
rm -rf repo
git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" repo
if [ ! -d repo/ryze-test ]; then echo 'ryze-test/ not found on branch ${BRANCH}'; exit 1; fi
cp -r repo/ryze-test/. /mnt/server/
cd /mnt/server
rm -rf node_modules dist .env data .auth-cache
echo 'Install complete. Set env vars (JWT_SECRET, DASHBOARD_PASSWORD, MCP_TOKEN) before starting.'

variables.name: Dashboard Password
variables.description: Owner login password for the web dashboard.

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Long random string used to sign dashboard sessions.

variables.name: MCP Token
variables.description: Bearer token every MCP client (Claude Code is primary) must present. Keep secret.

variables.name: MCP Allow Sessions
variables.description: true lets the primary AI MCP client (Claude Code) start/stop test sessions itself. Dangerous server commands still require owner approval.

variables.name: Safety Mode
variables.description: safe = dangerous commands need owner approval. open = no gate.

variables.name: Action Rate / min
variables.description: Max actions per minute per client.

variables.name: HTTP Port
variables.description: Dashboard/MCP HTTP port. Leave EMPTY to auto-use the server's primary allocation port (recommended). Only set a number if you proxy a different internal port.

variables.name: Viewer Enabled
variables.description: true enables optional 3D render (needs native deps; heavier).
